# Demand Range

> Demand Range is an Irish industrial account research business that builds evidence-backed target account lists for suppliers of industrial equipment, technology and services selling in Ireland, the UK and the EU. Research covers sectors such as water, pharma, food and beverage, and chemicals. Where public evidence exists, each account comes with project or development context.

Tagline: Evidence-backed industrial account research for Ireland, the UK and the EU

Key facts:
- Website: https://demandrange.com
- Contact: partners@demandrange.com, or request a written scope at https://demandrange.com/request-a-quote
- Markets served: Ireland, the UK and the EU. Each territory's sources and language needs are assessed per brief.
- Customers: suppliers of industrial equipment, technology and services, such as pumps and flow control, water and wastewater, process equipment, MRO, OEM components and distribution.
- Two research classes: industry-matched ("Look Alike") accounts that match an agreed brief, and opportunity-signal accounts with an identified, evidenced project or development. The target mix is 90% industry-matched and 10% opportunity-signal accounts. This is a target, not a guarantee; counts and class treatment are agreed in writing.
- Deliverable: company-level account records with fit reasoning, sources, review dates and open questions. Named contacts, emails and direct dials are not included by default.
- What it is not: not a self-service data platform, live intent feed or contact database. It does not guarantee meetings, pipeline or revenue.

## Services

- [Home](https://demandrange.com/): the two research classes, the 90/10 target mix and what a company-level account record contains
- [Industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-lead-research): company-level account research for Ireland, the UK and the EU, scoped by country, sector, site rules and exclusions
- [Industrial lead generation for Ireland and the UK](https://demandrange.com/industrial-lead-generation-ireland-uk): account research for Ireland, the UK and the EU, with Irish and UK sources set out in detail: CRO, Companies House, regulator registers and public tenders
- [Opportunity Intelligence](https://demandrange.com/opportunity-intelligence): evidenced industrial project and development signals, separating observed change, supplier relevance and unknowns
- [Markets and supplier fit](https://demandrange.com/markets): how account fit is defined by country, sector and customer route
- [Methodology](https://demandrange.com/methodology): how fit is checked, signals are classified and sources and unknowns are recorded
- [Request a quote](https://demandrange.com/request-a-quote): form to request a written scope; fields, coverage and deliverables are agreed before any work starts

## Guides for industrial sales teams

- [Industrial sales research guides and templates](https://demandrange.com/industrial-sales-resources): index of guides and free worksheets (CSV, plus one XLSX workbook), with no form or sign-up
- [What is industrial account research? A definition for industrial suppliers](https://demandrange.com/what-is-industrial-account-research): A definition of industrial account research: what it is, how it differs from bought contact data and meeting-booking services, and what evidence a good account record carries.
- [Industrial lead generation methods compared](https://demandrange.com/industrial-lead-generation-approaches-compared): How industrial suppliers in Ireland, the UK and the EU find accounts: agencies, data providers, project databases, tenders, registers and researched lists
- [Manufacturing enterprises in the EU by country and NACE Rev. 2 division (2024 data)](https://demandrange.com/eu-industrial-enterprises-by-country): EU manufacturing enterprises by country and NACE Rev. 2 division for 2024, from Eurostat, with a downloadable CSV and notes on what the counts can and cannot tell you
- [Manufacturing share of GVA by EU country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-gva-by-country): Eurostat 2025 data on manufacturing's share of gross value added in all 27 EU countries. Ireland leads at 30.84%, by our count.
- [EU manufacturing production by product (Prodcom)](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-production-prodcom): How to use Eurostat's Prodcom database to see what each EU country's plants make by product, in value and volume, which cells are confidential, and why the UK is no longer covered
- [Pump and valve production by EU country](https://demandrange.com/eu-pump-valve-production-by-country): Eurostat Prodcom sold production of pumps and valves by country for 2024 and 2025, why EU trade is extra-EU only, and Ireland's position
- [EU manufacturing enterprise churn by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-enterprise-churn): Eurostat manufacturing birth, death and official churn rates, EU-27 and each country, 2024 (deaths provisional) and 2023, with tables and a free CSV (CC BY 4.0)
- [EU manufacturing purchases by country 2024](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-purchases-by-country): Eurostat 2024 purchases of goods and services by EU manufacturers, by country and NACE division, with confidential cells flagged. EU-27: €7.33tn
- [EU industrial energy use by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-industrial-energy-use-by-country): Eurostat energy balance (nrg_bal_c) figures on final energy use in industry, by subsector and EU country, 2023 and 2024, in ktoe. Physical energy use only, not energy purchases in euro or the Irish energy-audit obligation
- [EU industrial production index by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-industrial-production-index-by-country): Eurostat's industrial production index by country and NACE division, 2021 = 100, with the latest month
- [Manufacturing GHG emissions by EU country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-emissions-by-country): Manufacturing greenhouse gas emissions by EU country and sector, from Eurostat air emissions accounts, with Ireland's 2025 EPA figure and how to use it
- [EU manufacturing turnover by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-turnover-by-country): Eurostat turnover growth by country for manufacturing, electrical equipment and machinery, home and export, to 2026
- [Manufacturing digital intensity by EU country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-digital-intensity-by-country): Eurostat's Digital Intensity Index by country, with Ireland's ranking, cloud take-up and what the score means
- [Innovative manufacturers: Ireland vs the EU](https://demandrange.com/manufacturing-innovation-ireland-eu): CSO and Eurostat innovation survey data for Ireland and the EU by size and ownership, and how to use it as a fit signal
- [ICT specialists in EU manufacturing](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-ict-specialists): Eurostat 2024 data on the share of manufacturers that employ ICT specialists, by EU country and sector, with Ireland's position
- [Manufacturing cyber incidents by EU country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-ict-security-incidents): Eurostat data on how many EU manufacturers had an ICT security incident in 2023, why failures outnumbered attacks, and Ireland against the EU
- [EU manufacturing employment by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-employment-by-country): Eurostat persons employed in manufacturing by country and NACE division, with Ireland against the EU
- [EU manufacturing labour costs by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-labour-costs-by-country): Eurostat hourly labour-cost levels and the quarterly index by country, with Ireland and the EU
- [EU manufacturing producer prices by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-producer-prices-by-country): Eurostat factory-gate producer price index for manufacturing by country, monthly, with Ireland and the EU
- [EU manufacturing capacity utilisation](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-capacity-utilisation): Quarterly factory capacity use in manufacturing by country from the EU business survey, and what it can say about capex timing
- [EU manufacturing investment by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-investment-by-country): Eurostat gross fixed capital formation in manufacturing by country, with Ireland against the EU
- [EU manufacturing job vacancy rate by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-manufacturing-job-vacancies): Eurostat quarterly job vacancy rates in manufacturing by country, with Ireland and the EU
- [EU industry bankruptcies by country](https://demandrange.com/eu-industry-bankruptcies-by-country): Eurostat's quarterly bankruptcy index (2021=100) for industry by country, plus Ireland's annual counts
- [UK industrial emissions register research](https://demandrange.com/uk-industrial-emissions-register-research): use the official UK PRTR and England's Pollution Inventory to research industrial sites the EU Industrial Emissions Portal does not cover in Great Britain
- [COMAH and Seveso site lists for Ireland and the UK](https://demandrange.com/seveso-comah-site-research): Where to find the official COMAH and Seveso site lists for Ireland, Great Britain and Northern Ireland, what each shows, and how suppliers can use them
- [How to build a list of UK manufacturers](https://demandrange.com/uk-manufacturing-account-research): ONS counts about 128,000 UK manufacturing businesses (March 2026); confirm each company's identity and operating site
- [UK manufacturing sites by nation](https://demandrange.com/uk-manufacturing-sites-by-nation): ONS March 2026 counts of manufacturing sites and enterprises in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, by size band, for territory planning
- [UK manufacturing output by industry](https://demandrange.com/uk-manufacturing-output-by-industry): ONS index of production by industry, monthly, and what it means for industrial suppliers
- [Companies House advanced search by SIC](https://demandrange.com/companies-house-industrial-prospecting): use Companies House advanced search by SIC code to find UK industrial companies, export a CSV and read filings; a registered office is not a plant
- [How to use TED to find EU tenders for industrial suppliers](https://demandrange.com/ted-eu-tenders-industrial-suppliers): CPV search, notice types and the 2026–2027 EU thresholds
- [EU state aid awards as industrial signals](https://demandrange.com/eu-state-aid-industrial-signals): How to search the Commission's transparency awards and use them as investment signals
- [CPV codes for pumps, valves and industrial equipment](https://demandrange.com/cpv-codes-industrial-equipment): official CPV wording for pumps, valves, instruments, water treatment and plant maintenance, with a free CSV starter list for tender alerts
- [UK public tenders for industrial suppliers](https://demandrange.com/uk-public-tenders-industrial-suppliers): Find a Tender vs Contracts Finder under the Procurement Act 2023, and which notices matter
- [UK water industry supplier research (AMP8)](https://demandrange.com/uk-water-industry-supplier-research): water companies, framework contractors and DPC routes in England and Wales for 2025–2030
- [EU wastewater treatment plant research](https://demandrange.com/eu-wastewater-treatment-plant-research): How to use EEA UWWTD reported data (data call 2023, final public version, October 2025) to research urban wastewater plants by country, capacity and load
- [NACE Rev. 2.1 codes for industrial account lists](https://demandrange.com/nace-rev-2-1-industrial-account-lists): the manufacturing (Section C) changes and how to recode an existing target list
- [EU Industrial Emissions Portal for account research](https://demandrange.com/eu-industrial-emissions-portal-research): using the EEA's EU-wide facility data to find large industrial sites by country and activity
- [EU ETS installations for account research](https://demandrange.com/eu-ets-installation-account-research): Use EU and UK ETS registry files to find plants with verified emissions: installation counts by country and activity, and what a listing can prove
- [Germany industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/germany-industrial-account-research): Handelsregister, Unternehmensregister, WZ 2025 codes and other public sources for German manufacturers and plants
- [Find industrial customers in Austria](https://demandrange.com/austria-industrial-account-research): How to research industrial accounts in Austria: Eurostat counts, Statistik Austria, the company register, ÖNACE codes and public tenders, step by step
- [France industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/france-industrial-account-research): Find industrial customers in France from public data: Eurostat counts, INSEE Sirene, NAF 2025 codes, BOAMP and PLACE tenders, and ICPE site records
- [Italy industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/italy-industrial-account-research): Research Italian manufacturers using Eurostat and ISTAT counts, the Registro Imprese, ATECO 2025 codes and ANAC public-contract open data
- [Poland industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/poland-industrial-account-research): Find manufacturing companies in Poland from public data: Eurostat counts, GUS REGON local units, KRS and CEIDG, PKD 2025 and e-Zamówienia tenders
- [Czechia industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/czechia-industrial-account-research): Research Czech manufacturers with Eurostat counts, the CZSO business register, ARES, the public register, CZ-NACE 2025 and NEN and ISVZ tenders
- [Hungary industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/hungary-industrial-account-research): How to research manufacturing accounts in Hungary: official statistics, the company register and public sources
- [Romania industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/romania-industrial-account-research): How to research manufacturing accounts in Romania: official statistics, the company register and public sources
- [Slovakia industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/slovakia-industrial-account-research): How to research manufacturing accounts in Slovakia: official statistics, the company register and public sources
- [Portugal industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/portugal-industrial-account-research): Research Portuguese manufacturers using INE business counts, the commercial register, CAE-Rev.4 activity codes and the BASE public-contracts portal
- [Netherlands and Belgium process industry account research](https://demandrange.com/netherlands-belgium-process-industry-research): Find process industry companies in the Netherlands and Belgium with Eurostat and CBS counts, KvK and KBO registers, SBI and NACE-BEL codes and tenders
- [Nordic process industry account research](https://demandrange.com/nordic-industrial-supplier-research): Research Nordic process-industry accounts: Eurostat and national counts for Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Norway (EEA), plus registers, codes and tenders
- [Spain industrial account research](https://demandrange.com/spain-industrial-account-research): Research Spanish manufacturers using INE DIRCE counts, the Registro Mercantil, CNAE-2025 and the official public procurement platform
- [EU approved food establishment lists: how equipment suppliers find food and beverage plants](https://demandrange.com/eu-food-beverage-plant-research): Where to find EU approved food establishments lists for each member state, Ireland and the UK, what each row shows, and how suppliers turn rows into accounts.
- [UK food and drink manufacturer research](https://demandrange.com/uk-food-drink-manufacturer-research): How many there are, the official lists that name them, and how to research them
- [SIC codes for manufacturing companies in the UK: the Section C list, SIC 2026 and how to search](https://demandrange.com/uk-sic-codes-manufacturing): The full UK SIC 2007 Section C list of manufacturing codes as accepted by Companies House, what SIC 2026 changes, and how to search manufacturers by code, with a CSV.
- [ZoomInfo or Apollo for industrial prospect lists?](https://demandrange.com/industrial-prospect-list-vs-data-provider): when a data platform is enough and how to test any source
- [Industrial project leads Ireland and UK](https://demandrange.com/industrial-project-leads-ireland-uk): How construction project databases, capex trackers, public tenders and account research differ for industrial suppliers in Ireland and the UK
- [Industrial ideal customer profile](https://demandrange.com/industrial-ideal-customer-profile): a six-field manufacturing ICP template with weights, a scored fictional example and the NACE, SIC and register evidence for each field
- [Industrial buying committees: who to research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-buying-committee-research): The roles in a typical industrial buying committee and how to research them account by account
- [Industrial lookalike account research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-lookalike-account-research): how to find companies like existing customers from NACE or SIC codes, size bands, regulator evidence and site type
- [Industrial account prioritisation](https://demandrange.com/industrial-account-prioritisation): a weighted fit, evidence and timing score with a scored fictional example and a research queue; fit stays a gate
- [Hiring signals for industrial accounts](https://demandrange.com/industrial-hiring-signals): How to read a public job advertisement as an account signal, and where that reading misleads
- [B2B prospect list audit](https://demandrange.com/industrial-prospect-list-audit): a one-off audit of a supplied industrial list for duplicates, holds, rejects and true company counts, with a fictional example
- [Prospect list maintenance](https://demandrange.com/industrial-prospect-list-maintenance): change triggers, a review cadence, retain, hold, correct or remove decisions and a blank review log
- [B2B contact data decay evidence](https://demandrange.com/b2b-contact-data-decay-evidence): the 22.5% and 70.3% a year B2B data-decay figures are vendor claims, not official rates; use Eurostat job-to-job data as a labour-market proxy
- [Insolvency signals for industrial accounts](https://demandrange.com/industrial-insolvency-account-signals): Official insolvency notices in Ireland and the UK, and how to use them to risk-check an account list
- [Industrial MRO account research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-mro-account-research): finding MRO-heavy sites in Ireland with CSO and Eurostat counts, then checking who repairs, supplies and restocks the parts
- [EPC/EPCM equipment supplier research](https://demandrange.com/epc-epcm-equipment-supplier-research): tracing a TED award to the contractor's package and to who specifies, approves and orders the equipment
- [European chemical manufacturer research](https://demandrange.com/european-chemical-manufacturer-research): Eurostat counts 31,749 EU chemical manufacturing enterprises (NACE C20, 2024); separating production, formulation and distribution before adding a site
- [EU pharmaceutical manufacturing site research](https://demandrange.com/eu-pharmaceutical-manufacturing-site-research): By our count, EudraGMDP listed 7,292 manufacturing authorisations in the 27 EU countries on 10 Nov 2026. Search by country, then check GMP certificates
- [Medical device manufacturer research](https://demandrange.com/medical-device-manufacturer-research): How to research medical-device manufacturers in Ireland, the UK and the EU from EUDAMED, HPRA, MHRA and Eurostat NACE classes 26.60 and 32.50
- [Pump and flow-control prospect research](https://demandrange.com/pump-flow-control-prospecting): scoping pump and flow-control account research in Ireland, the UK and the EU by country and company role
- [Energy-audit signals for industrial suppliers](https://demandrange.com/energy-audit-industrial-supplier-signals): EED Article 11 energy audits, published action plans and SEAI's LIEN as research signals, with a fictional example
- [CSRD and suppliers: what buyers can ask for](https://demandrange.com/csrd-supplier-data-requests): After Omnibus I, which companies still report under CSRD, and what they can ask an industrial supplier for, including the value-chain cap

## Ireland-specific research guides

- [Irish manufacturing account research](https://demandrange.com/irish-manufacturing-account-research): setting the brief, resolving company and site identity, then include, hold or reject; CSO counts 19,617 manufacturing enterprises in Ireland (2024)
- [NACE codes for Irish manufacturing: using CSO data to size and build account lists](https://demandrange.com/irish-manufacturing-nace-codes): Which NACE divisions matter to industrial suppliers in Ireland, how many enterprises CSO and Eurostat count in each, and how to build account lists from them.
- [Irish pharmaceutical manufacturing account research](https://demandrange.com/irish-pharmaceutical-manufacturing-account-research): HPRA authorisations in EudraGMDP and EPA licences, then checking each site's activity against the brief
- [Irish food and beverage company research](https://demandrange.com/irish-food-beverage-company-research): the EPA, DAFM, FSAI and Origin Green lists and what each one shows about a site
- [Irish water investment supplier research](https://demandrange.com/irish-water-investment-supplier-research): separating Irish water funding announcements from project and equipment evidence
- [Irish planning applications as supplier signals](https://demandrange.com/irish-construction-planning-signals): Use Irish planning applications as early industrial-project signals: the data.gov.ie national dataset, council files and An Coimisiún Pleanála records
- [Irish eTenders for industrial suppliers](https://demandrange.com/etenders-industrial-supplier-opportunities): the €50,000 and €200,000 thresholds, CPV alerts and a method to triage each notice by scope
- [Irish eTenders data by CPV and volume](https://demandrange.com/irish-public-tenders-industrial-equipment-data): OGP recorded 8,004 contracts advertised on eTenders in 2025, with a median of 3 bids. Open-data counts for supplies and CPV 42
- [Irish environmental register evidence](https://demandrange.com/irish-environmental-register-evidence): reading Irish EPA registers and PRTR returns: coverage, dossier records, site identity and discharge evidence
- [Data centre construction supplier research](https://demandrange.com/data-centre-construction-supplier-research): Research Irish data-centre construction with CSO electricity figures, planning records and CRU and EirGrid connection rules. A rumour is not a project
- [IDA Ireland announcements as account signals](https://demandrange.com/ida-fdi-investment-account-signals): Turn official IDA Ireland investment announcements into site-level account research, using IDA's 2025 results and planning and EPA licence checks
- [Irish industrial distributor research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-distributor-research-ireland): finding Irish industrial distributors via the CRO, trade associations and manufacturer pages, with fictional cases
- [Irish industrial OEM account research](https://demandrange.com/industrial-oem-account-research-ireland): CSO 2024 counts for machinery and electrical makers, and how to find which build operation buys a component
- [Electrical equipment manufacturing in Ireland](https://demandrange.com/irish-electrical-equipment-manufacturing): Eurostat turnover and Prodcom data on Irish electrical equipment, home and export, and how Ireland compared with other EU countries in 2025
- [Who works in Irish industry: occupations data](https://demandrange.com/irish-industry-workforce-by-occupation): CSO Labour Force Survey figures for Q3 2026 on occupations in Irish industry — operatives, professionals and trades — and what they mean for sales
- [Irish manufacturing productivity: latest data](https://demandrange.com/irish-manufacturing-productivity): CSO Q2 2026 output per hour in foreign-dominated and domestic manufacturing sectors, and why the two move in opposite directions
- [Irish manufacturing exporters by firm size](https://demandrange.com/irish-manufacturing-exporters-by-size): Eurostat 2024 data on how many Irish manufacturers export, and how concentrated export value is by firm size, compared with Germany, France, Spain and Poland
- [Foreign-owned industry in Ireland: data](https://demandrange.com/foreign-owned-industry-ireland): CSO counts of Irish industry enterprises, jobs and turnover by ownership, and why averages mislead for account research
- [Business R&D in Irish manufacturing](https://demandrange.com/irish-manufacturing-rd-spending): CSO and Eurostat business R&D data for 2021 and 2023, who spends it, and why 2024 figures don't agree yet
- [How Irish manufacturers use their websites](https://demandrange.com/irish-manufacturer-websites-online-sales): Eurostat 2025 data on what Irish manufacturers' websites do: product information, online ordering and languages, against the EU
- [Irish capital goods imports: 2026 data](https://demandrange.com/irish-capital-goods-imports): CSO monthly data on Irish imports of producer capital goods, January to September 2026, what counts, and how equipment suppliers can use it
- [Irish manufacturing turnover by month](https://demandrange.com/irish-manufacturing-turnover): CSO monthly turnover for Irish manufacturing in 2025 and 2026, by sector, and what the swings mean for industrial suppliers
- [Irish domestic industrial production index](https://demandrange.com/irish-domestic-industrial-production): CSO's domestic production index, which excludes contract manufacturing abroad, against the headline index
- [Irish decarbonisation grant signals](https://demandrange.com/irish-industrial-decarbonisation-grant-signals): Public SEAI and Enterprise Ireland programme data, and how to read it as an account signal. No complete public recipient list is published
- [Irish plastics and packaging manufacturers](https://demandrange.com/irish-plastics-packaging-manufacturer-research): Sector size, the public registers that name them, and how to research them
